claims.claim: Supports inbound policies that trigger every message, replies only, or no broker message, and otherwise steers delivery into a busy session.
Includes attachment content in the agent-visible body and delivers an accepted message by triggering an idle session or steering a busy interactive session.
Registers a child-only supervisor tool when orchestrator metadata is present and a native supervisor channel is unavailable.
Registers direct session messaging actions for listing, sending, asking, replying, pending asks, status, cancellation, attachments, and cwd-scoped targeting.
Records successfully sent message text and attachments in Pi session history.
Records an ask and its received reply, including attachments, in Pi session history.
Resolves one target, validates reply and supersede relationships, and routes the message only to that target socket.
Keeps a bounded in-memory mailbox and replays queued messages only when the reconnecting session matches its ID or a unique same-directory name identity.
Uses owner-restricted runtime modes, a Unix socket or Windows named pipe by default, and an explicitly selected loopback TCP transport on Windows.
Selects local socket or named-pipe paths by default and only resolves a loopback TCP endpoint after explicit Windows opt-in.
Creates the runtime directory with owner-only access and restricts runtime files on Unix-like systems.
